description: Ministry of Highways - Declaration of Godagama - Kasagala road as Godagama - Kasagala National Highway (Section of Southern Expressway
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order made under Section 11 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, designating a specific highway stretch as an "User Fee National Highway." This constitutes a regulatory action and legal instrument issued under existing legislation, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim, it does so only in the context of exercising statutory powers and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes that would make it a government-related type.
